title: Telecommunications (Designated Telecommunication Licensees) Notifications: Gazette copy of S 24/2011
kind: the Gazette's text of the instrument, deposited as the instrument's text (IMDA's list did not include it)
header_as_printed: 1 S 24/2011 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 17th January 2011 at 5:00 pm. / NO. first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 17th January 2011 at 5:00 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch2.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/ (page said "Last updated on 10 July 2026" when read on 2026-11-03), clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
